definition: II. שָׁעַר verb calculate, reakon (Late Hebrew Pi`el Jewish-Aramaic Pa`el put a valuation, estimate ; Jewish-Aramaic שַׁעֲרָא interest, market-price ; Arabic market-price is loan-word Frä 189 ); — Qal Perfect 3 masculine singular בְּנַפְשׁוֺ כֶּןהֿוּא ׳ כְּמוֺשֿׁ Prov 23:7 as he has calculated in his soul, so is he , but dubious: De שֹׁעֵר as one who calculates ; more radical conjectures in Bi Toy.
